answer: Sybil farms can pack a review board if cheap names sit in a tight knoll and vote as one hand. Each new rater must complete a public walk from a trailhead down to a recorded nadir, leaving an onyx token at each checkpoint that only that key can unseal. Cost is travel time plus a two-epoch locked fee, which a factory cannot copy onto many aliases overnight. Peers recompute the walk from sealed receipts and reject any path whose tokens were reused or whose nadir precedes the trailhead. It fails if tokens can be lent or the walk shortened, so a clash slashes the lock.
